# STEAMsational

> > STEAMsational provides NGSS-aligned STEM and STEAM lesson plans, hands-on science activities, and educational resources for elementary educators and homeschool families.

Founded by Brenda, STEAMsational offers comprehensive lesson plan bundles, seasonal science experiments, and creative learning activities spanning chemistry, engineering, and early childhood education. The site emphasizes practical, low-prep activities that integrate science, technology, engineering, art, and mathematics for ages 3-12.

## Key Topics

- NGSS-aligned lesson plans
- STEM activities
- STEAM education
- Hands-on learning
- Elementary science
- Lesson plan bundles
- Preschool activities
- Fall activities
- Alphabet crafts
- Chemistry experiments
- LEGO building projects
- Science fair projects
- Seasonal STEM activities
- Printable worksheets
- Homeschool resources

## STEAM Lesson Plan Bundles

- [12 Month STEAM Lesson Plan Bundle](https://www.steamsational.com/12-month-steam-lesson-plan-bundle): Year-long STEAM lesson plan bundle with NGSS-aligned activities
- [Apple STEM Lesson Plan Bundle](https://www.steamsational.com/apple-stem-lesson-plan-bundle): NGSS-aligned apple STEM lesson plans for ages 5-11, fall activities
- [April STEAM Lesson Plan Bundle](https://www.steamsational.com/april-steam-lesson-plan-bundle): Spring STEAM lesson plans for April, NGSS-aligned ages 5-12

## STEM & Science Activities

- [Creative STEM Activities for Kids: 31 Ideas To Try Right Now!](https://www.steamsational.com/31-days-stem-activities-kids): 31 creative STEM projects and hands-on science activities for kids
- [14 Fall Chemistry Experiments for Kids](https://www.steamsational.com/13-fall-chemistry-experiments-for-kids): Low-prep fall chemistry experiments for elementary & middle school
- [Brilliant Apple STEM Activities Kids Will Love](https://www.steamsational.com/apple-stem-activities): 20 apple-themed STEM activities for fall elementary classroom
- [Science Fair Projects for Active Kids Who Need to Move](https://www.steamsational.com/adhd-science-fair-projects): Kinesthetic science fair projects for active learners with ADHD

## Seasonal & Holiday Activities

- [3D Christmas Tree Engineering Challenge for Kids](https://www.steamsational.com/3d-paper-christmas-tree-engineering): Holiday STEAM challenge building 3D paper Christmas tree
- [Easy Instructions to Make a 3D LEGO Pumpkin](https://www.steamsational.com/3d-lego-pumpkin): Step-by-step LEGO building instructions for fall pumpkin creation
- [20+ Creative Animals in Winter Preschool Activities](https://www.steamsational.com/animals-in-winter-preschool-activities): Winter and arctic animal activities for preschool science themes

## Preschool & Early Learning

- [Easy A-Z Alphabet Crafts with Animal Themes!](https://www.steamsational.com/alphabet-crafts): Complete A-Z animal alphabet crafts for letter-of-the-week activities
- [A is for Alligator Letter Craft](https://www.steamsational.com/a-is-for-alligator-letter-craft): Preschool alphabet craft for letter A recognition and sounds
- [B is for Beaver Alphabet Craft](https://www.steamsational.com/b-is-for-beaver-letter-craft): Letter B beaver craft for kindergarten alphabet and phonics learning
- [Aquarium I Spy Counting Worksheet](https://www.steamsational.com/aquarium-i-spy-counting-worksheet): Preschool math worksheet counting aquarium creatures 1-10
